title: Decentralized distributed learning method and system for non-shared data
assignee: Shenzhen International Graduate School of Tsinghua University

pse.problem: Data privacy requirements prevent top companies from sharing data for combined modeling in AI industry, leading to slow communication and unstable communication efficiency in federal learning.
pse.solution_function: A decentralized distributed learning method performs local updates using participant's data, desensitizes the updated parameters or gradients, and uploads them to update a global model. The server aggregates the results from multiple participants and updates the global model.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of servers and participating clients. Each client has local data and is equipped with hardware for computation. Servers are responsible for managing modeling tasks, initializing the system, aggregating results, and updating the global model.
pse.solution_implementation: In each iteration, the server sends a modeling task to a participant and provides the initial parameters of the model. The client performs local update using local data, desensitizes the updated parameters or gradients, and uploads them back to the server for aggregation. After aggregating results from multiple participants, the server updates the global model and sends it to the participating clients for the next iteration.
pse.effect: Reduced communication times between server and client, improved communication efficiency, and accelerated convergence process by selecting only part of clients to participate in each iteration based on a fixed rule or protocol.
